static_evaluation: Destructuring now_ts=Date.now() replaces explicit undefined with T.
Object.hasOwn(arguments[1],'now_ts') checks property existence only and returns true.
Number.isSafeInteger(now_ts) checks substituted local T rather than original supplied undefined and returns true; epoch bound also passes.
Guard therefore sets earlyCutoff=T-600000 and adds SQL lower bound although caller supplied no fixed integer.
Wrapper at294 separately checks Number.isSafeInteger(arguments[1].now_ts), so the wrapper vector with now_ts:undefined falls back correctly. The defect is the direct loader API.
